description: Whether a source's API key is set up (never shows the key) and, if not, what the user does. When a key is set up and the source has a live check, it is tested with one small call to the agency's own site: key.live.outcome is accepted, rejected (code key_rejected, with the fix), unreachable (the host did not answer; the key was not tested) or unclear. Sources without a live check say tested: false. live: false skips the call.

live.description: false: only say whether a key is set up (no call)

name: check_key
title: Check key
